Order and Disorder

Or, The World Made and Undone. Being Meditations upon the Creation and the Fall; As it is recorded in the beginning of Genesis

Lucy Hutchinson

Misattributed for 400 years, this beginning of the greatest epic rarely read stands as a personal reconstruction of faith by a stalwart woman, Puritan and poet during England’s Century of Revolution.
